# Zapixal

> Zapixal is a free, browser-local image converter and compressor operating client-side via WebAssembly and Canvas API. Zero server uploads for standard conversions, adaptive batch file processing, and EXIF metadata stripping.

Zapixal processes images locally inside browser memory to support user privacy.

## Core Features
- [HEIC to JPG](/convert-heic-to-jpg-locally): Convert HEIC files to JPG format locally in browser.
- [JPEG Compression](/client-side-private-image-compressor): Compress JPEG and PNG files under specific target file sizes (e.g., 200KB, 100KB).
- [Format Converter](/convert-png-to-webp-lossless): Convert between PNG, JPG, WEBP, AVIF, and PDF.
- [EXIF Metadata Remover](/strip-exif-metadata-online-private): Strip GPS location data and device camera info from photos.

## Optional
- [Sitemap](/sitemap.xml): Full list of programmatic conversion tools and routes.
